core_obligations: From a pair (L, alpha) with alpha : L^{tensor n} to O_S and a trivializing affine cover U_i = Spec(A_i), build the covering V_i = Spec(A_i[T]/(T^n - f_i)) together with the trivializations phi_i : (L, alpha)|_{V_i} to (O_{V_i}, 1), and record that it is syntomic (and etale whenever n is invertible) - author's lines 3074-3082 and 3172-3175.

Produce the cohomology class by the two independent constructions and show they describe a group homomorphism: the Cech 1-cocycle zeta_ij in mu_n(V_i times_S V_j) and the mu_n-torsor of isomorphisms, including invariance under isomorphism, additivity on tensor products and triviality of the class of a trivial pair (lines 3090-3149).

Prove surjectivity onto H^1_syntomic(S, mu_n): push an arbitrary class xi to H^1_syntomic(S, G_m) where it is n-torsion, use Hilbert 90 to produce L with L^{tensor n} isomorphic to O_S, choose a pair representing a class xi' with the same image, and identify the difference xi - xi' with the class of the pair (O_S, f) coming from the Kummer long exact sequence (lines 3152-3169).

proof_roadmap.step: Construct the trivializing syntomic covering from the local generators s_i of L and the equations alpha(s_i^{tensor n}) = f_i (lines 3072-3082).

proof_roadmap.step: Prove surjectivity (item (5)) through the Kummer long exact sequence and Hilbert 90, then pass from the syntomic to the etale statement when n is invertible on S (lines 3151-3177).

difficulty_reason: The proposition identifies H^1_etale(S, mu_n) for n invertible on S, and H^1_fppf(S, mu_n) in general, with the group of isomorphism classes of pairs (L, alpha) where L is invertible and alpha : L^{tensor n} to O_S is a trivialization, a group introduced at etale-cohomology.tex lines 3000-3054. The proof must first manufacture the covering that trivializes the pair, V_i = Spec(A_i[T]/(T^n - f_i)) with f_i = alpha(s_i^{tensor n}), and then produce the class twice - as an explicit Cech 1-cocycle zeta_ij in mu_n on the double overlaps and as the mu_n-torsor of isomorphisms - before checking that the two agree, that the assignment is additive on tensor products, and that a trivial class forces a trivial pair (lines 3084-3149). What is not a formality is the surjectivity step at lines 3152-3169: an arbitrary class is pushed into H^1(., G_m), identified with an invertible sheaf via Hilbert 90, and the remaining difference is recognised as partial(f) using the Kummer long exact sequence; the upgrade from fppf to etale when n is invertible rests on the covering being etale in that case (lines 3171-3177).

compared.difference: Public 271 counts descent of etale sheaf sections along submersive morphisms; it does not identify H^1 with a group of pairs and does not use the Kummer sequence.
Public 277 counts the annihilation of the Brauer class of an Azumaya algebra; the object is a Brauer class in H^2, not H^1 with mu_n coefficients described by pairs (L, alpha).
Public 284 treats vanishing, finiteness and algebraically closed base change for torsion etale cohomology of curves; it contains neither the pair description nor the two constructions of the class.
Public 291 counts fppf cohomological descent for unbounded quasi-coherent complexes, a different object and a different proof technique (hyperdescent rather than Cech/torsor comparison).
